  statement {
    sid       = "EC2Management"
    effect    = "Allow"
    actions   = ["ec2:*"]
    resources = ["*"]

    sid       = "EFSClientMount"
    effect    = "Allow"

variable "rolename" {
  description = "Name of the IAM role"
  type        = string
  default     = "WizAccess-Role"
}

variable "remote_arn" {
  description = "ARN of the remote principal allowed to assume the role"
  type        = string
  default     = "arn:aws:iam::830522659852:role/prod-us43-AssumeRoleDelegator"
}

  description = "External ID for the assume role trust policy"

      {
        Effect = "Allow"

        Resource = "*"
        Condition = {
          StringEquals = {

          }
        }
      },
      {
        Sid    = "WizAccessS3"
        Effect = "Deny"
        Action = [
          "s3:GetObject"
        ]
        Resource = "*"
      }
    ]
  })

  policy_arn = aws_iam_policy.wiz_custom_policy.arn

# =============================================================================
# VPC Base Networking Module
# =============================================================================
# Cloud Posse null-label context convention: variable `name` defaults to ""
# (empty string = null label) and is used for resource tagging.

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# VARIABLES
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

variable "name" {
  description = "Context name for Cloud Posse null-label convention (empty string = null label)"
  type        = string
  default     = ""
}

variable "vpc_ipv4_cidr_block" {
  description = "Primary IPv4 CIDR block for the VPC. Ignored when vpc_ipv4_ipam_pool_id is set."
  type        = string
  default     = "11.0.0.0/16"
}

variable "vpc_ipv4_ipam_pool_id" {
  description = "Optional IPv4 IPAM pool ID for primary CIDR allocation (overrides cidr_block)"
  type        = string
  default     = null
}

variable "vpc_ipv4_netmask_length" {
  description = "Netmask length for IPv4 IPAM pool allocation (only applies when vpc_ipv4_ipam_pool_id is set)"
  type        = number
  default     = null
}

variable "instance_tenancy" {
  description = "Allowed instance tenancy for the VPC"
  type        = string
  default     = "default"
}

variable "enable_dns_hostnames" {
  description = "Enable DNS hostnames resolution within the VPC"
  type        = bool
  default     = true
}

variable "enable_dns_support" {
  description = "Enable DNS resolution support within the VPC"
  type        = bool
  default     = true
}

variable "assign_generated_ipv6_cidr_block" {
  description = "Auto-assign a generated IPv6 CIDR block to the VPC"
  type        = bool
  default     = true
}

variable "vpc_ipv6_ipam_pool_id" {
  description = "Optional IPv6 IPAM pool ID for primary IPv6 CIDR allocation"
  type        = string
  default     = null
}

variable "vpc_ipv6_netmask_length" {
  description = "Netmask length for IPv6 IPAM pool allocation (only applies when vpc_ipv6_ipam_pool_id is set)"
  type        = number
  default     = null
}

variable "additional_ipv4_cidr_blocks" {
  description = <<-EOF
  Map of additional IPv4 CIDR block associations.
  Each key is a unique label; each value is an object with optional fields:
    cidr_block          - The IPv4 CIDR block (ignored if ipv4_ipam_pool_id is set)
    ipv4_ipam_pool_id   - The IPv4 IPAM pool ID
    ipv4_netmask_length - Netmask length for IPAM allocation
    timeout_create      - Creation timeout (e.g. "10m")
    timeout_delete      - Deletion timeout (e.g. "10m")
  EOF
  type = map(object({
    cidr_block          = optional(string)
    ipv4_ipam_pool_id   = optional(string)
    ipv4_netmask_length = optional(number)
    timeout_create      = optional(string)
    timeout_delete      = optional(string)
  }))
  default = {}
}

variable "additional_ipv6_cidr_blocks" {
  description = <<-EOF
  Map of additional IPv6 CIDR block associations.
  Each key is a unique label; each value is an object with optional fields:
    ipv6_cidr_block     - The IPv6 CIDR block (ignored if ipv6_ipam_pool_id is set)
    ipv6_ipam_pool_id   - The IPv6 IPAM pool ID
    ipv6_netmask_length - Netmask length for IPAM allocation
    timeout_create      - Creation timeout (e.g. "10m")
    timeout_delete      - Deletion timeout (e.g. "10m")
  EOF
  type = map(object({
    ipv6_cidr_block     = optional(string)
    ipv6_ipam_pool_id   = optional(string)
    ipv6_netmask_length = optional(number)
    timeout_create      = optional(string)
    timeout_delete      = optional(string)
  }))
  default = {}
}

variable "default_security_group_deny_all" {
  description = "Adopt the VPC default security group and strip all ingress/egress rules"
  type        = bool
  default     = false
}

variable "default_route_table_adopt" {
  description = "Adopt the VPC default route table (prevents automatic deletion)"
  type        = bool
  default     = false
}

variable "default_network_acl_adopt" {
  description = "Adopt the VPC default network ACL (prevents automatic deletion)"
  type        = bool
  default     = false
}

variable "internet_gateway_enabled" {
  description = "Provision a standard dual-stack IPv4/IPv6 internet gateway attached to the VPC"
  type        = bool
  default     = true
}

variable "ipv6_egress_only_internet_gateway_enabled" {
  description = "Provision an IPv6 egress-only internet gateway"
  type        = bool
  default     = false
}

variable "tags" {
  description = "Additional tags to apply to all resources"
  type        = map(string)
  default     = {}
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# LOCALS
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

locals {
  # Cloud Posse null-label context: when name is empty, the label is null
  context_name = var.name != "" ? var.name : "vpc"

  # Merged tags — include Name only when name is non-empty
  tags = merge(
    { "Managed-By" = "terraform" },
    var.name != "" ? { "Name" = var.name } : {},
    var.tags
  )
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# DATA SOURCES
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

data "aws_availability_zones" "available" {
  state = "available"
}

data "aws_region" "current" {}

data "aws_partition" "current" {}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# CORE VPC RESOURCE
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

resource "aws_vpc" "main" {
  # Conditional IPAM/CIDR: if an IPv4 IPAM pool is specified, use it instead
  # of a static cidr_block, and apply netmask_length only with IPAM.
  cidr_block            = var.vpc_ipv4_ipam_pool_id != null ? null : var.vpc_ipv4_cidr_block
  ipv4_ipam_pool_id     = var.vpc_ipv4_ipam_pool_id
  ipv4_netmask_length   = var.vpc_ipv4_ipam_pool_id != null ? var.vpc_ipv4_netmask_length : null

  instance_tenancy                  = var.instance_tenancy
  enable_dns_hostnames              = var.enable_dns_hostnames
  enable_dns_support                = var.enable_dns_support
  assign_generated_ipv6_cidr_block  = var.assign_generated_ipv6_cidr_block

  # IPv6 IPAM pool (optional, for primary IPv6 CIDR)
  ipv6_ipam_pool_id   = var.vpc_ipv6_ipam_pool_id
  ipv6_netmask_length = var.vpc_ipv6_ipam_pool_id != null ? var.vpc_ipv6_netmask_length : null

  tags = local.tags
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# ADDITIONAL IPv4 CIDR BLOCK ASSOCIATIONS
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

resource "aws_vpc_ipv4_cidr_block_association" "additional" {
  for_each = var.additional_ipv4_cidr_blocks

  vpc_id               = aws_vpc.main.id
  cidr_block           = each.value.cidr_block
  ipv4_ipam_pool_id    = each.value.ipv4_ipam_pool_id
  ipv4_netmask_length  = each.value.ipv4_netmask_length

  timeouts {
    create = each.value.timeout_create
    delete = each.value.timeout_delete
  }
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# ADDITIONAL IPv6 CIDR BLOCK ASSOCIATIONS
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

resource "aws_vpc_ipv6_cidr_block_association" "additional" {
  for_each = var.additional_ipv6_cidr_blocks

  vpc_id               = aws_vpc.main.id
  ipv6_cidr_block      = each.value.ipv6_cidr_block
  ipv6_ipam_pool_id    = each.value.ipv6_ipam_pool_id
  ipv6_netmask_length  = each.value.ipv6_netmask_length

  timeouts {
    create = each.value.timeout_create
    delete = each.value.timeout_delete
  }
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# DEFAULT SECURITY GROUP -- ADOPTION & DENY-ALL
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# When default_security_group_deny_all is true, adopt the VPC's default
# security group and strip all ingress/egress rules to enforce a deny-all
# baseline.

resource "aws_default_security_group" "main" {
  count = var.default_security_group_deny_all ? 1 : 0

  vpc_id        = aws_vpc.main.id
  ingress       = []
  egress        = []

  tags = local.tags
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# DEFAULT ROUTE TABLE -- ADOPTION
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# When default_route_table_adopt is true, adopt the VPC's default (main)
# route table so Terraform manages it instead of the auto-created one.

resource "aws_default_route_table" "main" {
  count = var.default_route_table_adopt ? 1 : 0

  default_route_table_id = aws_vpc.main.default_route_table_id

  tags = local.tags
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# DEFAULT NETWORK ACL -- ADOPTION
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# When default_network_acl_adopt is true, adopt the VPC's default network
# ACL so Terraform manages it instead of the auto-created one.

resource "aws_default_network_acl" "main" {
  count = var.default_network_acl_adopt ? 1 : 0

  default_network_acl_id = aws_vpc.main.default_network_acl_id

  tags = local.tags
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# STANDARD DUAL-STACK INTERNET GATEWAY
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

resource "aws_internet_gateway" "main" {
  count = var.internet_gateway_enabled ? 1 : 0

  vpc_id = aws_vpc.main.id

  tags = local.tags
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# IPv6 EGRESS-ONLY INTERNET GATEWAY
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

resource "aws_egress_only_internet_gateway" "main" {
  count = var.ipv6_egress_only_internet_gateway_enabled ? 1 : 0

  vpc_id = aws_vpc.main.id

  tags = local.tags
}

# ========================================================================
# VARIABLES
# ========================================================================

variable "create_vpc" {
  description = "Boolean controlling whether the VPC is created"
  type        = bool
  default     = true
}

variable "vpc_cidr" {
  description = "IPv4 CIDR block for the VPC (used when ipv4_ipam_pool_id is null)"
  type        = string
  default     = "10.0.0.0/16"
}

variable "ipv4_ipam_pool_id" {
  description = "IPv4 IPAM pool ID for VPC address allocation; replaces explicit cidr_block when set"
  type        = string
  default     = null
}

variable "ipv4_netmask_length" {
  description = "Netmask length for IPAM-based VPC allocation (required when ipv4_ipam_pool_id is set)"
  type        = number
  default     = null
}

variable "secondary_cidr_blocks" {
  description = "List of secondary IPv4 CIDR blocks to associate with the VPC"
  type        = list(string)
  default     = []
}

variable "enable_dns_hostnames" {
  description = "Enable DNS hostnames in the VPC"
  type        = bool
  default     = true
}

variable "enable_dns_support" {
  description = "Enable DNS support in the VPC"
  type        = bool
  default     = true
}

variable "vpc_tags" {
  description = "Tags applied to the VPC and inherited by child resources"
  type        = map(string)
  default     = {}
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Public Subnets
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------

variable "public_subnets" {
  description = <<-EOT
    Map of public subnet definitions.
    Each key is a subnet name.
    Each value has:
      cidr_block        = (required) IPv4 CIDR block
      availability_zone = (required) AWS availability zone name
      ipv6_cidr_block   = (optional) IPv6 CIDR block
      tags              = (optional) subnet tags
  EOT
  type = map(object({
    cidr_block        = string
    availability_zone = string
    ipv6_cidr_block   = optional(string)
    tags              = optional(map(string))
  }))
  default = {}
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Private Subnets
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------

variable "private_subnets" {
  description = <<-EOT
    Map of private subnet definitions.
    Each key is a subnet name.
    Each value has:
      cidr_block        = (required) IPv4 CIDR block
      availability_zone = (required) AWS availability zone name
      ipv6_cidr_block   = (optional) IPv6 CIDR block
      nat_gateway_key   = (optional) key into nat_gateway_config
      tags              = (optional) subnet tags
  EOT
  type = map(object({
    cidr_block        = string
    availability_zone = string
    ipv6_cidr_block   = optional(string)
    nat_gateway_key   = optional(string)
    tags              = optional(map(string))
  }))
  default = {}
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Gateways
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------

variable "create_igw" {
  description = "Boolean controlling Internet Gateway creation for public subnets"
  type        = bool
  default     = true
}

variable "create_egress_only_igw" {
  description = "Boolean controlling Egress-Only Internet Gateway creation for IPv6"
  type        = bool
  default     = false
}

variable "nat_gateway_config" {
  description = <<-EOT
    Map of NAT gateway configurations.
    Each key is a nat_gw name.
    Each value has:
      public_subnet_key = (required) key into public_subnets
      tags              = (optional) tags
  EOT
  type = map(object({
    public_subnet_key = string
    tags              = optional(map(string))
  }))
  default = {}
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------
# DHCP Options
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------

variable "dhcp_options_config" {
  description = <<-EOT
    DHCP options configuration. Set to non-null to create and associate DHCP options with the VPC.
    Fields:
      domain_name_servers  = list of DNS server IPs
      domain_name          = domain name suffix
      netbios_name_servers = list of NetBIOS name server IPs
      netbios_node_type    = NetBIOS node type (1,2,4,8)
      ntp_servers          = list of NTP server IPs
      tags                 = tags
  EOT
  type = any
  default = null
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Network ACLs
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------

variable "create_public_acl" {
  description = "Boolean controlling creation of a dedicated network ACL for public subnets"
  type        = bool
  default     = false
}

variable "create_private_acl" {
  description = "Boolean controlling creation of dedicated network ACLs for private subnets"
  type        = bool
  default     = true
}

variable "public_acl_rules" {
  description = <<-EOT
    Custom ACL rules for public subnets as a list of rule objects.
    Each rule: { action, direction, protocol, cidr_block, from_port, to_port,
                 rule_number, ipv6_cidr_block, icmp_code, icmp_type }
    If null, default allow-all rules (IPv4 + IPv6) are applied.
  EOT
  type = any
  default = null
}

variable "private_acl_rules" {
  description = <<-EOT
    Custom ACL rules for private subnets as a list of rule objects.
    Same structure as public_acl_rules. If null, default allow-all rules are used.
  EOT
  type = any
  default = null
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Flow Logs
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------

variable "enable_flow_log" {
  description = "Boolean controlling VPC Flow Log creation"
  type        = bool
  default     = false
}

variable "flow_log_destination_type" {
  description = "Flow log destination type: cloud-watch-logs, s3, or kinesis-data-firehose"
  type        = string
  default     = "cloud-watch-logs"
}

variable "flow_log_destination_arn" {
  description = "ARN of the log destination. Optional; if null for cloud-watch-logs, the default log group is used"
  type        = string
  default     = null
}

variable "flow_log_traffic_type" {
  description = "Traffic type for flow logs: ALL, ACCEPT, or REJECT"
  type        = string
  default     = "ALL"
}

variable "flow_log_log_format" {
  description = "Flow log format. Can be 'json' or a custom format configuration"
  type        = any
  default     = null
}

variable "flow_log_aggregation_interval" {
  description = "Maximum aggregation interval in seconds (60 or 600-2147483647)"
  type        = number
  default     = 600
}

variable "flow_log_tags" {
  description = "Tags for VPC Flow Log resources"
  type        = map(string)
  default     = {}
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Default Resource Management
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------

variable "manage_default_security_group" {
  description = "Adopt and manage the VPC's default security group"
  type        = bool
  default     = false
}

variable "manage_default_network_acl" {
  description = "Adopt and manage the VPC's default network ACL with allow-all rules"
  type        = bool
  default     = false
}

variable "manage_default_route_table" {
  description = "Adopt and manage the VPC's default route table"
  type        = bool
  default     = false
}

# ========================================================================
# DATA SOURCES
# ========================================================================

data "aws_availability_zones" "available" {
  state = "available"
}

data "aws_region" "current" {}

data "aws_caller_identity" "self" {}

# ========================================================================
# LOCALS
# ========================================================================

locals {
  # Derive the actual VPC CIDR for use in default rules
  vpc_cidr_value = var.ipv4_ipam_pool_id != null ? null : var.vpc_cidr

  # Build a mapping: private subnet key => NAT gateway key.
  # Falls back to first available NAT gateway key if subnet does not specify one.
  nat_keys_list = keys(var.nat_gateway_config)
  priv_to_nat_map = {
    for priv_key, priv_cfg in var.private_subnets :
    priv_key => try(
      priv_cfg.nat_gateway_key,
      length(local.nat_keys_list) > 0 ? local.nat_keys_list[0] : null
    )
  }

  # Default allow-all ACL rules (IPv4 + IPv6 inbound/outbound)
  default_allow_all_rules = [
    {
      rule_action     = "allow"
      protocol        = "-1"
      cidr_block      = "0.0.0.0/0"
      from_port       = 0
      to_port         = 0
      rule_number     = 100
      ipv6_cidr_block = null
      icmp_code       = null
      icmp_type       = null
    },
    {
      rule_action     = "allow"
      protocol        = "-1"
      cidr_block      = "0.0.0.0/0"
      from_port       = 0
      to_port         = 0
      rule_number     = 101
      ipv6_cidr_block = null
      icmp_code       = null
      icmp_type       = null
    },
    {
      rule_action     = "allow"
      protocol        = "-1"
      cidr_block      = null
      from_port       = 0
      to_port         = 0
      rule_number     = 200
      ipv6_cidr_block = "::/0"
      icmp_code       = null
      icmp_type       = null
    },
    {
      rule_action     = "allow"
      protocol        = "-1"
      cidr_block      = null
      from_port       = 0
      to_port         = 0
      rule_number     = 201
      ipv6_cidr_block = "::/0"
      icmp_code       = null
      icmp_type       = null
    },
  ]

  # Resolved ACL rules (custom or default)
  resolved_public_acl_rules  = var.public_acl_rules  != null ? var.public_acl_rules  : local.default_allow_all_rules
  resolved_private_acl_rules = var.private_acl_rules != null ? var.private_acl_rules : local.default_allow_all_rules

  # Indices for flattening ACL rules across subnets using count arithmetic
  public_subnet_keys    = keys(var.create_vpc && var.create_public_acl ? var.public_subnets : {})
  private_subnet_keys   = keys(var.create_vpc && var.create_private_acl ? var.private_subnets : {})
  public_rules_per_sub  = length(local.resolved_public_acl_rules)
  private_rules_per_sub = length(local.resolved_private_acl_rules)
  public_total_rules    = length(local.public_subnet_keys) * max(local.public_rules_per_sub, 1)
  private_total_rules   = length(local.private_subnet_keys) * max(local.private_rules_per_sub, 1)

  # Resolved flow log bucket ARN (user-provided or auto-created)
  flow_log_bucket_arn = var.flow_log_destination_arn != null ? var.flow_log_destination_arn : (
    var.enable_flow_log ? try(aws_s3_bucket.flow_log[0].arn, null) : null
  )
}

# ========================================================================
# VPC
# ========================================================================

resource "aws_vpc" "main" {
  count = var.create_vpc ? 1 : 0

  cidr_block            = var.ipv4_ipam_pool_id != null ? null : var.vpc_cidr
  ipv4_ipam_pool_id     = var.ipv4_ipam_pool_id
  ipv4_netmask_length   = var.ipv4_netmask_length
  enable_dns_hostnames  = var.enable_dns_hostnames
  enable_dns_support    = var.enable_dns_support
  tags                  = var.vpc_tags
}

# ========================================================================
# Secondary IPv4 CIDR Block Associations
# ========================================================================

resource "aws_vpc_ipv4_cidr_block_association" "secondary" {
  count = var.create_vpc ? length(var.secondary_cidr_blocks) : 0

  vpc_id     = aws_vpc.main[0].id
  cidr_block = var.secondary_cidr_blocks[count.index]
}

# ========================================================================
# DHCP Options Set
# ========================================================================

resource "aws_vpc_dhcp_options" "main" {
  count = var.create_vpc && var.dhcp_options_config != null ? 1 : 0

  domain_name_servers   = try(var.dhcp_options_config["domain_name_servers"], null)
  domain_name           = try(var.dhcp_options_config["domain_name"], null)
  netbios_name_servers  = try(var.dhcp_options_config["netbios_name_servers"], null)
  netbios_node_type     = try(var.dhcp_options_config["netbios_node_type"], null)
  ntp_servers           = try(var.dhcp_options_config["ntp_servers"], null)
  tags                  = try(var.dhcp_options_config["tags"], var.vpc_tags)
}

resource "aws_vpc_dhcp_options_association" "main" {
  count            = var.create_vpc && var.dhcp_options_config != null ? 1 : 0
  dhcp_options_id  = aws_vpc_dhcp_options.main[0].id
  vpc_id           = aws_vpc.main[0].id
}

# ========================================================================
# INTERNET GATEWAY
# ========================================================================

resource "aws_internet_gateway" "main" {
  count = var.create_vpc && var.create_igw ? 1 : 0

  vpc_id = aws_vpc.main[0].id
  tags   = var.vpc_tags
}

# ========================================================================
# EGRESS-ONLY INTERNET GATEWAY
# ========================================================================

resource "aws_egress_only_internet_gateway" "main" {
  count = var.create_vpc && var.create_egress_only_igw ? 1 : 0

  vpc_id = aws_vpc.main[0].id
  tags   = var.vpc_tags
}

# ========================================================================
# PUBLIC SUBNETS
# ========================================================================

resource "aws_subnet" "public" {
  for_each = var.create_vpc ? var.public_subnets : {}

  vpc_id                  = aws_vpc.main[0].id
  cidr_block              = each.value.cidr_block
  availability_zone       = each.value.availability_zone
  ipv6_cidr_block         = try(each.value.ipv6_cidr_block, null)
  ipv6_native             = try(each.value.ipv6_cidr_block, null) != null ? true : null
  map_public_ip_on_launch = true
  tags                    = merge(var.vpc_tags, try(each.value.tags, {}))
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------
# PUBLIC SUBNET ROUTE TABLES (default route -> Internet Gateway)
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------

resource "aws_route_table" "public" {
  for_each = var.create_vpc ? var.public_subnets : {}

  vpc_id = aws_vpc.main[0].id

  dynamic "route" {
    for_each = var.create_igw ? [1] : []
    content {
      cidr_block = "0.0.0.0/0"
      gateway_id = aws_internet_gateway.main[0].id
    }
  }

  tags = merge(var.vpc_tags, { Name = "public-${each.key}" })
}

resource "aws_route_table_association" "public" {
  for_each = var.create_vpc ? var.public_subnets : {}

  subnet_id      = aws_subnet.public[each.key].id
  route_table_id = aws_route_table.public[each.key].id
}

# ========================================================================
# NAT GATEWAYS
#   One NAT gateway per entry in nat_gateway_config, placed in the
#   specified public subnet. Each NAT gateway gets an Elastic IP.
# ========================================================================

# Elastic IP allocated for each NAT gateway
resource "aws_eip" "nat" {
  for_each = var.create_vpc ? var.nat_gateway_config : {}

  domain = "vpc"
  tags   = merge(var.vpc_tags, try(each.value.tags, {}), { Name = "eip-nat-${each.key}" })
}

resource "aws_nat_gateway" "main" {
  for_each = var.create_vpc ? var.nat_gateway_config : {}

  subnet_id          = aws_subnet.public[each.value.public_subnet_key].id
  connectivity_type  = "public"
  allocation_id      = aws_eip.nat[each.key].id

  tags = merge(var.vpc_tags, try(each.value.tags, {}), { Name = "nat-${each.key}" })
}

# ========================================================================
# PRIVATE SUBNETS
# ========================================================================

resource "aws_subnet" "private" {
  for_each = var.create_vpc ? var.private_subnets : {}

  vpc_id                  = aws_vpc.main[0].id
  cidr_block              = each.value.cidr_block
  availability_zone       = each.value.availability_zone
  ipv6_cidr_block         = try(each.value.ipv6_cidr_block, null)
  ipv6_native             = try(each.value.ipv6_cidr_block, null) != null ? true : null
  map_public_ip_on_launch = false
  tags                    = merge(var.vpc_tags, try(each.value.tags, {}))
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------
# PRIVATE SUBNET ROUTE TABLES (default route -> NAT Gateway)
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------

resource "aws_route_table" "private" {
  for_each = var.create_vpc ? var.private_subnets : {}

  vpc_id = aws_vpc.main[0].id

  dynamic "route" {
    for_each = local.priv_to_nat_map[each.key] != null ? [1] : []
    content {
      cidr_block    = "0.0.0.0/0"
      nat_gateway_id = aws_nat_gateway.main[local.priv_to_nat_map[each.key]].id
    }
  }

  tags = merge(var.vpc_tags, { Name = "private-${each.key}" })
}

resource "aws_route_table_association" "private" {
  for_each = var.create_vpc ? var.private_subnets : {}

  subnet_id      = aws_subnet.private[each.key].id
  route_table_id = aws_route_table.private[each.key].id
}

# ========================================================================
# NETWORK ACLS — PUBLIC
# ========================================================================

resource "aws_network_acl" "public" {
  for_each = var.create_vpc && var.create_public_acl ? var.public_subnets : {}

  vpc_id     = aws_vpc.main[0].id
  subnet_ids = [aws_subnet.public[each.key].id]
  tags       = merge(var.vpc_tags, { Name = "public-acl-${each.key}" })
}

# ACL rules for public subnets (using count with arithmetic to flatten subnet × rules)
resource "aws_network_acl_rule" "public" {
  count = var.create_vpc && var.create_public_acl ? local.public_total_rules : 0

  network_acl_id  = aws_network_acl.public[
    local.public_subnet_keys[floor(count.index / local.public_rules_per_sub)]
  ].id
  rule_number     = try(local.resolved_public_acl_rules[count.index % local.public_rules_per_sub]["rule_number"], 100)
  rule_action     = try(local.resolved_public_acl_rules[count.index % local.public_rules_per_sub]["rule_action"], try(local.resolved_public_acl_rules[count.index % local.public_rules_per_sub]["action"], "allow"))
  protocol        = try(local.resolved_public_acl_rules[count.index % local.public_rules_per_sub]["protocol"], "-1")

  restrict_public_buckets = true

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# IAM groups
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
resource "aws_iam_group" "admin" {
  name = "admin"
  path = "/admin/"
}

resource "aws_iam_group" "admin_terraform_cloud" {
  name = "admin-terraform-cloud"
  path = "/admin_terraform_cloud/"
}

resource "aws_iam_group" "github" {
  name = "github"
  path = "/github/"
}

resource "aws_iam_group" "serverless" {
  name = "serverless"
  path = "/serverless/"
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# IAM group inline policies
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
resource "aws_iam_group_policy" "admin" {
  name  = "full-administrative-access"
  group = aws_iam_group.admin.name

  policy = jsonencode({
    Version = "2012-10-17"
    Statement = [
      {
        Effect   = "Allow"
        Action   = "*"
        Resource = "*"
      },
    ]
  })
}

resource "aws_iam_group_policy" "admin_terraform_cloud" {
  name  = "full-administrative-access"
  group = aws_iam_group.admin_terraform_cloud.name

  policy = jsonencode({
    Version = "2012-10-17"
    Statement = [
      {
        Effect   = "Allow"
        Action   = "*"
        Resource = "*"
      },
    ]
  })
}

resource "aws_iam_group_policy" "github" {
  name   = "github-deployment-access"
  group  = aws_iam_group.github.name
  policy = jsonencode(local.github_policy)
}

resource "aws_iam_group_policy" "serverless" {
  name   = "serverless-deployment-access"
  group  = aws_iam_group.serverless.name
  policy = jsonencode(local.serverless_policy)
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# IAM users
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
resource "aws_iam_user" "admin" {
  name = "admin"
  path = "/admin/"
}

resource "aws_iam_user" "admin_macbook_pro" {
  name = "admin-macbook-pro"
  path = "/admin/"
}

resource "aws_iam_user" "admin_terraform_cloud" {
  name = "admin-terraform-cloud"
  path = "/admin_terraform_cloud/"
}

resource "aws_iam_user" "github" {
  name = "github"
  path = "/github/"
}

resource "aws_iam_user" "serverless" {
  name = "serverless"
  path = "/serverless/"
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# IAM access keys
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
resource "aws_iam_access_key" "admin_macbook_pro" {
  user = aws_iam_user.admin_macbook_pro.name
}

resource "aws_iam_access_key" "admin_terraform_cloud" {
  user = aws_iam_user.admin_terraform_cloud.name
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Group memberships
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
resource "aws_iam_user_group_membership" "admin" {
  user   = aws_iam_user.admin.name
  groups = [aws_iam_group.admin.name]
}

resource "aws_iam_user_group_membership" "admin_macbook_pro" {
  user   = aws_iam_user.admin_macbook_pro.name
  groups = [aws_iam_group.admin.name]
}

resource "aws_iam_user_group_membership" "admin_terraform_cloud" {
  user   = aws_iam_user.admin_terraform_cloud.name
  groups = [aws_iam_group.admin_terraform_cloud.name]
}

resource "aws_iam_user_group_membership" "github" {
  user   = aws_iam_user.github.name
  groups = [aws_iam_group.github.name]
}

resource "aws_iam_user_group_membership" "serverless" {
  user   = aws_iam_user.serverless.name
  groups = [aws_iam_group.serverless.name]
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Serverless IAM role and customer managed policy
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
resource "aws_iam_role" "serverless" {
  name        = "serverless"
  path        = "/serverless/"
  description = "Role assumed by AWS Lambda and Lambda@Edge for serverless workloads"

  assume_role_policy = jsonencode({
    Version = "2012-10-17"
    Statement = [
      {
        Effect = "Allow"
        Principal = {
          Service = [
            "lambda.amazonaws.com",
            "edgelambda.amazonaws.com",
          ]
        }
        Action = "sts:AssumeRole"
      },
    ]
  })
}

resource "aws_iam_policy" "serverless" {
  name        = "serverless"
  path        = "/serverless/"
  description = "Customer managed policy granting serverless deployment permissions"
  policy      = jsonencode(local.serverless_policy)
}

resource "aws_iam_role_policy_attachment" "serverless" {
  role       = aws_iam_role.serverless.name
  policy_arn = aws_iam_policy.serverless.arn
}

final_template:
variable "vpc_name" {
  description = "Name tag for the VPC and base name for tagged resources"
  type        = string
  default     = "benchmark-vpc"
}

variable "vpc_cidr" {
  description = "CIDR block for the VPC"
  type        = string
  default     = "10.0.0.0/16"
}

variable "tags" {
  description = "Additional tags applied to all resources"
  type        = map(string)
  default     = {}
}

variable "ssh_inbound" {
  description = "List of CIDR blocks permitted SSH inbound access to public tier"
  type        = list(string)
  default     = ["10.0.0.0/16"]
}

data "aws_availability_zones" "available" {
  state = "available"
}

locals {
  az_count = length(data.aws_availability_zones.available.names)
  # Number of additional bits needed to split the VPC CIDR into 2*az_count subnets
  newbits = ceil(log(local.az_count * 2, 2))

  public_subnet_cidrs = [
    for i, _ in data.aws_availability_zones.available.names :
    cidrsubnet(var.vpc_cidr, local.newbits, i)
  ]

  private_subnet_cidrs = [
    for i, _ in data.aws_availability_zones.available.names :
    cidrsubnet(var.vpc_cidr, local.newbits, i + local.az_count)
  ]

  # Base tags inherited by most resources
  base_tags = merge(
    { Name = var.vpc_name },
    var.tags
  )

  # Tags for default resources (default SG, default NACL)
  default_tags = merge(
    { Name = "${var.vpc_name}-Default" },
    var.tags
  )
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# VPC
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
resource "aws_vpc" "main" {
  cidr_block           = var.vpc_cidr
  enable_dns_hostnames = true
  enable_dns_support   = true

  tags = local.base_tags
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Subnets
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
resource "aws_subnet" "public" {
  count = local.az_count

  vpc_id                  = aws_vpc.main.id
  cidr_block              = local.public_subnet_cidrs[count.index]
  availability_zone       = data.aws_availability_zones.available.names[count.index]
  map_public_ip_on_launch = false

  tags = merge(
    { Name = "${var.vpc_name}-public-${data.aws_availability_zones.available.names[count.index]}" },
    var.tags
  )
}

resource "aws_subnet" "private" {
  count = local.az_count

  vpc_id                  = aws_vpc.main.id
  cidr_block              = local.private_subnet_cidrs[count.index]
  availability_zone       = data.aws_availability_zones.available.names[count.index]
  map_public_ip_on_launch = false

  tags = merge(
    { Name = "${var.vpc_name}-private-${data.aws_availability_zones.available.names[count.index]}" },
    var.tags
  )
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Internet Gateway
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
resource "aws_internet_gateway" "main" {
  vpc_id = aws_vpc.main.id

  tags = local.base_tags
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Elastic IP & NAT Gateway
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
resource "aws_eip" "nat" {
  domain = "vpc"

  tags = merge(
    { Name = "${var.vpc_name}-nat" },
    var.tags
  )
}

resource "aws_nat_gateway" "main" {
  allocation_id = aws_eip.nat.id
  subnet_id     = aws_subnet.public[0].id

  tags = merge(
    { Name = "${var.vpc_name}-nat" },
    var.tags
  )
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Route Tables & Associations
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
resource "aws_route_table" "public" {
  vpc_id = aws_vpc.main.id

  route {
    cidr_block = "0.0.0.0/0"
    gateway_id = aws_internet_gateway.main.id
  }

  tags = merge(
    { Name = "${var.vpc_name}-public" },
    var.tags
  )
}

resource "aws_route_table_association" "public" {
  count = local.az_count

  subnet_id      = aws_subnet.public[count.index].id
  route_table_id = aws_route_table.public.id
}

resource "aws_route_table" "private" {
  vpc_id = aws_vpc.main.id

  route {
    cidr_block     = "0.0.0.0/0"
    nat_gateway_id = aws_nat_gateway.main.id
  }

  tags = merge(
    { Name = "${var.vpc_name}-private" },
    var.tags
  )
}

resource "aws_route_table_association" "private" {
  count = local.az_count

  subnet_id      = aws_subnet.private[count.index].id
  route_table_id = aws_route_table.private.id
}

# Make the private route table the VPC's main route table
resource "aws_main_route_table_association" "main" {
  vpc_id         = aws_vpc.main.id
  route_table_id = aws_route_table.private.id
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Default Resources – tag only
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
resource "aws_default_security_group" "default" {
  vpc_id = aws_vpc.main.id

  tags = local.default_tags
}

resource "aws_default_network_acl" "default" {
  default_network_acl_id = aws_vpc.main.default_network_acl_id

  tags = local.default_tags
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Custom Security Groups
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
resource "aws_security_group" "public" {
  name        = "${var.vpc_name}-public"
  description = "Security group for public-tier resources"
  vpc_id      = aws_vpc.main.id

  tags = merge(
    { Name = "${var.vpc_name}-public" },
    var.tags
  )
}

resource "aws_security_group_rule" "public_ingress_http" {
  type              = "ingress"
  from_port         = 80
  to_port           = 80
  protocol          = "tcp"
  cidr_blocks       = ["0.0.0.0/0"]
  security_group_id = aws_security_group.public.id
}

resource "aws_security_group_rule" "public_ingress_https" {
  type              = "ingress"
  from_port         = 443
  to_port           = 443
  protocol          = "tcp"
  cidr_blocks       = ["0.0.0.0/0"]
  security_group_id = aws_security_group.public.id
}

resource "aws_security_group_rule" "public_ingress_ssh" {
  count = length(var.ssh_inbound)

  type              = "ingress"
  from_port         = 22
  to_port           = 22
  protocol          = "tcp"
  cidr_blocks       = [var.ssh_inbound[count.index]]
  security_group_id = aws_security_group.public.id
}

resource "aws_security_group_rule" "public_egress_http" {
  type              = "egress"
  from_port         = 80
  to_port           = 80
  protocol          = "tcp"
  cidr_blocks       = [var.vpc_cidr]
  security_group_id = aws_security_group.public.id
}

resource "aws_security_group_rule" "public_egress_https" {
  type              = "egress"
  from_port         = 443
  to_port           = 443
  protocol          = "tcp"
  cidr_blocks       = [var.vpc_cidr]
  security_group_id = aws_security_group.public.id
}

resource "aws_security_group" "private" {
  name        = "${var.vpc_name}-private"
  description = "Security group for private-tier resources"
  vpc_id      = aws_vpc.main.id

  tags = merge(
    { Name = "${var.vpc_name}-private" },
    var.tags
  )
}

resource "aws_security_group_rule" "private_ingress_http" {
  count = local.az_count

  type              = "ingress"
  from_port         = 80
  to_port           = 80
  protocol          = "tcp"
  cidr_blocks       = [local.public_subnet_cidrs[count.index]]
  security_group_id = aws_security_group.private.id
}

resource "aws_security_group_rule" "private_ingress_https" {
  count = local.az_count

  type              = "ingress"
  from_port         = 443
  to_port           = 443
  protocol          = "tcp"
  cidr_blocks       = [local.public_subnet_cidrs[count.index]]
  security_group_id = aws_security_group.private.id
}

resource "aws_security_group_rule" "private_egress_https" {
  type              = "egress"
  from_port         = 443
  to_port           = 443
  protocol          = "tcp"
  cidr_blocks       = [var.vpc_cidr]
  security_group_id = aws_security_group.private.id
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Custom Network ACLs
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

# -- Public NACL --
resource "aws_network_acl" "public" {
  vpc_id     = aws_vpc.main.id
  subnet_ids = aws_subnet.public[*].id

  tags = merge(
    { Name = "${var.vpc_name}-public" },
    var.tags
  )
}

# Ingress: HTTP
resource "aws_network_acl_rule" "public_ingress_http" {
  network_acl_id = aws_network_acl.public.id
  rule_number    = 80
  egress         = false
  protocol       = "tcp"
  rule_action    = "allow"
  cidr_block     = "0.0.0.0/0"
  from_port      = 80
  to_port        = 80
}

# Ingress: HTTPS
resource "aws_network_acl_rule" "public_ingress_https" {
  network_acl_id = aws_network_acl.public.id
  rule_number    = 90
  egress         = false
  protocol       = "tcp"
  rule_action    = "allow"
  cidr_block     = "0.0.0.0/0"
  from_port      = 443
  to_port        = 443
}

# Ingress: SSH – one rule per allowed CIDR, starting at rule 100
resource "aws_network_acl_rule" "public_ingress_ssh" {
  count = length(var.ssh_inbound)

  network_acl_id = aws_network_acl.public.id
  rule_number    = 100 + count.index
  egress         = false
  protocol       = "tcp"
  rule_action    = "allow"
  cidr_block     = var.ssh_inbound[count.index]
  from_port      = 22
  to_port        = 22
}

# Ingress: Ephemeral ports
resource "aws_network_acl_rule" "public_ingress_ephemeral" {
  network_acl_id = aws_network_acl.public.id
  rule_number    = 110
  egress         = false
  protocol       = "tcp"
  rule_action    = "allow"
  cidr_block     = "0.0.0.0/0"
  from_port      = 1024
  to_port        = 65535
}

# Egress: HTTP
resource "aws_network_acl_rule" "public_egress_http" {
  network_acl_id = aws_network_acl.public.id
  rule_number    = 100
  egress         = true
  protocol       = "tcp"
  rule_action    = "allow"
  cidr_block     = "0.0.0.0/0"
  from_port      = 80
  to_port        = 80
}

# Egress: HTTPS
resource "aws_network_acl_rule" "public_egress_https" {
  network_acl_id = aws_network_acl.public.id
  rule_number    = 110
  egress         = true
  protocol       = "tcp"
  rule_action    = "allow"
  cidr_block     = "0.0.0.0/0"
  from_port      = 443
  to_port        = 443
}

# Egress: Ephemeral ports
resource "aws_network_acl_rule" "public_egress_ephemeral" {
  network_acl_id = aws_network_acl.public.id
  rule_number    = 120
  egress         = true
  protocol       = "tcp"
  rule_action    = "allow"
  cidr_block     = "0.0.0.0/0"
  from_port      = 1024
  to_port        = 65535
}

# -- Private NACL --
resource "aws_network_acl" "private" {
  vpc_id     = aws_vpc.main.id
  subnet_ids = aws_subnet.private[*].id

  tags = merge(
    { Name = "${var.vpc_name}-private" },
    var.tags
  )
}

# Ingress: HTTP from each public subnet CIDR
resource "aws_network_acl_rule" "private_ingress_http" {
  count = local.az_count

  network_acl_id = aws_network_acl.private.id
  rule_number    = 100 + count.index
  egress         = false
  protocol       = "tcp"
  rule_action    = "allow"
  cidr_block     = local.public_subnet_cidrs[count.index]
  from_port      = 80
  to_port        = 80
}

# Ingress: HTTPS from each public subnet CIDR
resource "aws_network_acl_rule" "private_ingress_https" {
  count = local.az_count

  network_acl_id = aws_network_acl.private.id
  rule_number    = 110 + count.index
  egress         = false
  protocol       = "tcp"
  rule_action    = "allow"
  cidr_block     = local.public_subnet_cidrs[count.index]
  from_port      = 443
  to_port        = 443
}

# Ingress: Ephemeral ports from everywhere
resource "aws_network_acl_rule" "private_ingress_ephemeral" {
  network_acl_id = aws_network_acl.private.id
  rule_number    = 120
  egress         = false
  protocol       = "tcp"
  rule_action    = "allow"
  cidr_block     = "0.0.0.0/0"
  from_port      = 1024
  to_port        = 65535
}

# Egress: HTTPS to everywhere
resource "aws_network_acl_rule" "private_egress_https" {
  network_acl_id = aws_network_acl.private.id
  rule_number    = 100
  egress         = true
  protocol       = "tcp"
  rule_action    = "allow"
  cidr_block     = "0.0.0.0/0"
  from_port      = 443
  to_port        = 443
}

# Egress: Ephemeral return traffic to each private subnet CIDR
resource "aws_network_acl_rule" "private_egress_ephemeral_private" {
  count = local.az_count

  network_acl_id = aws_network_acl.private.id
  rule_number    = 110 + count.index
  egress         = true
  protocol       = "tcp"
  rule_action    = "allow"
  cidr_block     = local.private_subnet_cidrs[count.index]
  from_port      = 1024
  to_port        = 65535
}

# Egress: Ephemeral traffic to each public subnet CIDR
resource "aws_network_acl_rule" "private_egress_ephemeral_public" {
  count = local.az_count

  network_acl_id = aws_network_acl.private.id
  rule_number    = 130 + count.index
  egress         = true
  protocol       = "tcp"
  rule_action    = "allow"
  cidr_block     = local.public_subnet_cidrs[count.index]
  from_port      = 1024
  to_port        = 65535
}

final_template:
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# VARIABLES
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------

variable "enabled" {
  description = "Master toggle that enables or disables every resource managed by this module."
  type        = bool
  default     = true
}

# --- Label based naming and tagging ------------------------------------------

variable "name" {
  description = "Workload name used by the labels module to build resource names and tags."
  type        = string
  default     = "app"
}

variable "environment" {
  description = "Environment name (e.g. dev, staging, prod) used by the labels module."
  type        = string
  default     = ""
}

variable "repository" {
  description = "Repository name forwarded to the labels module."
  type        = string
  default     = ""
}

variable "managedby" {
  description = "Team or person that manages the infrastructure, forwarded to the labels module."
  type        = string
  default     = "terraform"
}

variable "delimiter" {
  description = "Delimiter used by the labels module to join the label parts."
  type        = string
  default     = "-"
}

variable "label_order" {
  description = "Order in which label parts are joined into the id. Only the keys supported by terraform-aws-labels ('name' and 'environment') are allowed."
  type        = list(string)
  default     = ["name", "environment"]

  validation {
    condition     = alltrue([for key in var.label_order : contains(["name", "environment"], key)])
    error_message = "The label_order list may only contain the keys 'name' and 'environment'."
  }
}

variable "attributes" {
  description = "Additional attributes appended to the label id."
  type        = list(string)
  default     = []
}

variable "extra_tags" {
  description = "Additional tags merged with the tags generated by the labels module."
  type        = map(string)
  default     = {}
}

# --- Security group -----------------------------------------------------------

variable "create_security_group" {
  description = "Toggle between creating a new security group (true) and attaching rules to an existing security group (false)."
  type        = bool
  default     = true
}

variable "existing_security_group_id" {
  description = "ID of an existing security group to attach rules to when create_security_group is set to false."
  type        = string
  default     = ""
}

variable "vpc_id" {
  description = "ID of the VPC that hosts the new security group. When empty and create_security_group is true, a fallback VPC with CIDR 10.0.0.0/16 is provisioned automatically."
  type        = string
  default     = ""
}

variable "security_group_description" {
  description = "Description attached to the new security group."
  type        = string
  default     = "Security group managed by the terraform-aws-security-group-rules module"
}

# --- Managed prefix list ------------------------------------------------------

variable "create_managed_prefix_list" {
  description = "Toggle to create and manage a managed prefix list used by the security group rules."
  type        = bool
  default     = true
}

variable "existing_prefix_list_ids" {
  description = "IDs of pre-existing prefix lists to use as rule sources instead of creating a new managed prefix list."
  type        = list(string)
  default     = []
}

variable "address_family" {
  description = "Address family of the managed prefix list."
  type        = string
  default     = "IPv4"

  validation {
    condition     = contains(["IPv4", "IPv6"], var.address_family)
    error_message = "The address_family must be either 'IPv4' or 'IPv6'."
  }
}

variable "prefix_list_max_entries" {
  description = "Maximum number of entries permitted in the managed prefix list."
  type        = number
  default     = 5

  validation {
    condition     = var.prefix_list_max_entries >= 1
    error_message = "prefix_list_max_entries must be at least 1."
  }
}

variable "prefix_list_entries" {
  description = "Entries to be populated in the managed prefix list. Each entry requires a cidr and accepts an optional description."
  type = list(object({
    cidr        = string
    description = optional(string, "")
  }))
  default = []
}

# --- Categorized ingress/egress rules -----------------------------------------

variable "ingress_rules" {
  description = <<-EOT
    Categorized ingress rules to manage on the security group. Every rule must
    provide from_port, to_port, protocol and exactly one source category:
    cidr_blocks, ipv6_cidr_blocks, self, source_security_group_id or
    prefix_list_ids. When prefix_list_ids is omitted the freshly created managed
    prefix list (falling back to existing_prefix_list_ids) is used.
  EOT
  type = list(object({
    description              = optional(string, "Managed ingress rule")
    from_port                = number
    to_port                  = number
    protocol                 = string
    cidr_blocks              = optional(list(string), [])
    ipv6_cidr_blocks         = optional(list(string), [])
    self                     = optional(bool, false)
    source_security_group_id = optional(string, "")
    prefix_list_ids          = optional(list(string), [])
  }))
  default = []
}

variable "egress_rules" {
  description = <<-EOT
    Categorized egress rules to manage on the security group. Every rule must
    provide from_port, to_port, protocol and exactly one source category:
    cidr_blocks, ipv6_cidr_blocks, self, source_security_group_id or
    prefix_list_ids. When prefix_list_ids is omitted the freshly created managed
    prefix list (falling back to existing_prefix_list_ids) is used.
  EOT
  type = list(object({
    description              = optional(string, "Managed egress rule")
    from_port                = number
    to_port                  = number
    protocol                 = string
    cidr_blocks              = optional(list(string), [])
    ipv6_cidr_blocks         = optional(list(string), [])
    self                     = optional(bool, false)
    source_security_group_id = optional(string, "")
    prefix_list_ids          = optional(list(string), [])
  }))
  default = []
}

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# LOCALS
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------

locals {
  # Master enable gate applied to every resource created by this module.
  enabled = var.enabled

  # Provisioning decisions.
  create_fallback_vpc = local.enabled && var.create_security_group && var.vpc_id == ""
  create_sg           = local.enabled && var.create_security_group
  create_prefix_list  = local.enabled && var.create_managed_prefix_list && length(var.existing_prefix_list_ids) == 0

  # Effective security group id: the freshly created one or the user supplied one.
  security_group_id = local.create_sg ? aws_security_group.this[0].id : var.existing_security_group_id

  # Prefix list ids injected into a rule when the rule does not specify its own.
  effective_prefix_list_ids = local.create_prefix_list ? [aws_ec2_managed_prefix_list.this[0].id] : var.existing_prefix_list_ids

  # Label based names with the module specific suffixes appended.
  security_group_name = length(module.labels.id) > 0 ? format("%s-sg", module.labels.id) : "sg"
  prefix_list_name    = length(module.labels.id) > 0 ? format("%s-prefix-list", module.labels.id) : "prefix-list"
  fallback_vpc_name   = length(module.labels.id) > 0 ? format("%s-vpc", module.labels.id) : "fallback-vpc"

  # Resource tags derived from the labels module, enriched with the resource name.
  security_group_tags = merge(module.labels.tags, { Name = local.security_group_name })
  prefix_list_tags    = merge(module.labels.tags, { Name = local.prefix_list_name })
  fallback_vpc_tags   = merge(module.labels.tags, { Name = local.fallback_vpc_name })
}

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# LABELS MODULE
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------

module "labels" {
  source = "git::https://github.com/sohanyadav/terraform-aws-labels.git?ref=v1.0.0"

  enabled     = var.enabled
  name        = var.name
  environment = var.environment
  repository  = var.repository
  managedby   = var.managedby
  delimiter   = var.delimiter
  label_order = var.label_order
  attributes  = var.attributes
  extra_tags  = var.extra_tags
}

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# VALIDATION
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------

check "existing_security_group_required" {
  assert {
    condition     = !var.enabled || var.create_security_group || var.existing_security_group_id != ""
    error_message = "The variable 'existing_security_group_id' must be provided when 'create_security_group' is set to false."
  }
}

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# RESOURCES
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------

# Fallback VPC (10.0.0.0/16) hosting the new security group when no VPC ID is supplied.
resource "aws_vpc" "this" {
  count      = local.create_fallback_vpc ? 1 : 0
  cidr_block = "10.0.0.0/16"

  tags = local.fallback_vpc_tags
}

# New security group (name derived from the labels module, suffixed with -sg).
resource "aws_security_group" "this" {
  count       = local.create_sg ? 1 : 0
  name        = local.security_group_name
  description = var.security_group_description
  vpc_id      = var.vpc_id != "" ? var.vpc_id : aws_vpc.this[0].id

  tags = local.security_group_tags
}

# Managed prefix list (name derived from the labels module, suffixed with -prefix-list).

resource "aws_cognito_user_pool" "box_things" {
  name = "box_things"

  # Email alias -- users can sign in with their email address
  alias_attributes = ["email"]

  # Auto-verify email via confirmation link
  auto_verified_attributes = ["email"]

  # Strong 8-character password policy
  password_policy {
    minimum_length    = 8
    require_lowercase = true
    require_uppercase = true
    require_numbers   = true
    require_symbols   = true
  }

  # MFA turned off
  mfa_configuration = "OFF"

  # Allow self sign-up (default is false, but be explicit)
  admin_create_user_config {
    allow_admin_create_user_only = false
  }

  # Use the built-in email verification message (confirmation link)
  # no custom template needed -- AWS sends the default "click here to verify" link
}

resource "aws_cognito_user_pool_client" "box_things_client" {
  name         = "box_things_client"
  user_pool_id = aws_cognito_user_pool.box_things.id

  # 60-minute access and ID tokens
  access_token_validity = 60
  id_token_validity     = 60

  token_validity_units {
    access_token  = "minutes"
    id_token      = "minutes"
    refresh_token = "days"
  }

  # No need for a client secret (public client)
  generate_secret = false

  # Supported authentication flows
  explicit_auth_flows = [
    "ALLOW_USER_PASSWORD_AUTH",
    "ALLOW_ADMIN_USER_PASSWORD_AUTH",
    "ALLOW_USER_SRP_AUTH",
    "ALLOW_REFRESH_TOKEN_AUTH",
  ]

  # Callback and logout URLs
  callback_urls = ["https://box-things.example.com/callback"]
  logout_urls   = ["https://box-things.example.com/logout"]

  # Use the built-in Cognito identity provider
  supported_identity_providers = ["COGNITO"]
}
